_about.purpose: Held-out check of the Guardian Layer: not used to tune crisis-phrases.json or the risk prompt.
_about.author: Written on 8 October 2026 by the AI code reviewer (Claude), not by the team. The author had read the phrase list, so this is held-out but NOT blind.
_about.rule: Written before any run and not edited after seeing results. Items it misses must not be added to the phrase list without moving them to the dev set.
_about.review: Not reviewed by a native Libyan speaker or a clinician. Labels follow the risk prompt's scope: self-harm, suicidal ideation, immediate danger, or severe distress that needs a real person now.
_about.data: All sentences are synthetic. No real person's text.
